import pytest
from subject import (
    check_eval_regression,
    ModelEvalRegressionResult,
    DEFAULT_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD,
)
from omnibase_core.models.governance.model_eval_report import ModelEvalReport
from omnibase_core.models.governance.model_eval_summary import ModelEvalSummary


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_regression_detected_when_worse_ratio_exceeds_threshold():
    summary = ModelEvalSummary(
        total_tasks=10,
        onex_worse_count=4,
        onex_better_count=3,
        onex_tie_count=3,
    )
    report = ModelEvalReport(
        report_id="rpt-1",
        suite_id="suite-1",
        summary=summary,
    )
    result = check_eval_regression(report, threshold=0.30)
    assert result.is_regression is True
    assert result.worse_count == 4
    assert result.total_tasks == 10
    assert result.worse_ratio == 0.4
    assert result.threshold == 0.30
    assert result.report_id == "rpt-1"
    assert result.suite_id == "suite-1"
